## Outcome and context

Emily asked whether it would be easy / very low lift to surface a link (to the underlying record) directly in one of the related list table views on the Brand Ambassador record page.

## Current state

The BA Record Page doc under review (Alexander Kovacevic example) has two related list tables in the reviewed section: Deal Rep Assignments (Rep (BA)) — Deal, Deal Market, Deal Vertical, Deal Status columns; and Players Related List — Account Name, Player ID, Player Status, VIP columns. Neither is confirmed to currently expose a clickable link straight to the underlying Deal or Player record from the table view.

## Proposed solution

1. Confirm with Emily which related list table she meant — Deal Rep Assignments or Players Related List.
2. Assess Salesforce lift to add a link column / clickable record link to that related list.
3. If low lift, implement.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Confirmed which table view is in scope.
2. Lift assessed and communicated back to Emily.
3. If implemented, the related list table surfaces a working link to the underlying record.

## Dependencies

Related to BUILD-210 — Brand Ambassador: Players Related List (WAGR-166).

## Source

BA Record Page doc, comment from Emily Vandenberg (Sep 14, 2026): "@kobi@jumpr.io would it be easy / very low lift to surface the assigned link in this table view?"
